questions.question: What is the primary difference between biological Human Vision and Computer Vision?
options: Human vision only functions during daytime; computer vision works anytime
Human vision utilizes eyes and brain cells to interpret light; computer vision uses digital cameras, pixel arrays, and algorithms to capture and decode visual data
There is no difference between them, both use biological cells
Computer vision does not require electric power to capture images
questions.explanation: Perfect! Human vision is biological, whereas computer vision is an artificial intelligence system that processes digital image matrices to understand environments.

questions.question: Which OpenCV function is used to initialize the camera feed and capture live video frames from your default system webcam?
questions.explanation: Great! cv2.VideoCapture(0) targets the primary system camera (index 0) and initiates capturing video streams.

questions.question: Which algorithm in OpenCV relies on light and dark intensity differences (Haar-like features) to quickly locate and box human faces?
questions.explanation: Awesome! Haar Cascade is a fast, feature-based machine learning algorithm used to detect facial structures in real-time.

questions.question: Which command must be executed in the terminal to download and install the OpenCV library for Python?
questions.explanation: Excellent! The package name in the Python Package Index (PyPI) is opencv-python, which contains all cv2 functions.

questions.question: Simple Coding Task: Write a Python statement to import the OpenCV library (cv2) and print its version using the double underscore version property.
questions.explanation: Perfect! Verifying the installed OpenCV version confirms that the library is active and ready in your environment.

questions.question: Simple Coding Task: Write a Python statement to print the string: 'Face detection system active!'.
questions.explanation: Great! Confirming the activation of Haar Cascade classifiers ensures your face detection boxes are ready to draw.
